text:
sarah: Heads-up — canary run on qa-dedicated at 18:10Z showed a sustained throughput falloff. p50 spiked and tokens/s dropped. sharing quick logs and a repro command.

miguel: ack, saw the alert in the dashboard. any idea if this is kernel or infra?

sarah: initial tail shows KV cache hit-rate dipped ~from 82% -> 60% around 18:08, but also CPU steal on hosts. here's the snippet: 
```
[18:08:12] kv.hit_rate=0.60
[18:08:13] runtime.p50_ms=180
[18:08:13] host.cpu_steal=14%
[18:08:13] batch.size=6
```

priya: pinging @alex and @tom — Alex owns batching heuristics, Tom owns infra-side host metrics. can we triage quickly? :eyes:

alex: I can look at batching PRs — I merged a preload change yesterday (PR #678). Priya, is the canary using the new kernel?

priya: yes, canary used kernel v2.3.1 + batching-preload from staging.

tom: infra-bot shows a rolling kernel update on the GPU pool at 17:55; some hosts reported high I/O at 18:05. attaching host tail: 
```
Mar 15 18:05 host-32 kernel: nvme_io_queue depth spike
Mar 15 18:07 host-32 dockerd: container restart (OOM?)
```

miguel: hmm — could be interplay: batching preload increases disk reads for KV warmup during first requests, which + NVMe latency could throttle throughput. I'm assigning myself to look at kernel scheduling + KV warmup gating.

jamie: small ask — can we get a short reproduction script so SRE can replay? otherwise they'll waste cycles.

sarah: repro (one-liner): 
```bash
wrk -c200 -t12 -d300s http://qa-dedicated/api/v1/generate -s ./tests/ops/load_script.lua
```
Use model=redwood-7b, seq=1024, concurrency=200.

tom: starting a replay on a separate host now. will post traces.

alex: quick note — PR #678 added background KV prefetch that runs during first N tokens. if prefetch concurrency is uncapped it may cause IO bursts. I can do a hotfix to cap to 4 threads. pinging @priya for rollback approval if needed.

priya: approved for hotfix cap. can we patch and push a canary tomorrow morning 08:00 PT? need release note entry.

miguel: I'll add a kernel-side backpressure check to avoid spinning when NVMe latency > 10ms. tentative changes: cap-prefetch + sleep(10ms) loop. Will submit RFC and small patch, cc @alex.

sarah: thanks. for tracking: owners = miguel (kernel+kv), alex (batching PR + hotfix), tom (replay+infra traces), priya (release gate + rollout). We'll do async PRs and a short 15-min call if throughput not recovered by 22:00 UTC.

infra-bot: replay started on replay-07 at 18:30Z, trace id trace-20260315-7321.

tom: replay results so far — tokens/s recovered to baseline when I limited concurrent prefetch on host (-prefetch=4). attaching quick graph: tokens/s -> 115k (baseline) vs 48k (uncapped).

jamie: moving this to the sprint board as a blocker for this week. tagging with P0; will create checklist for canary rollback and hotfix. :white_check_mark:

sarah: Great. I'll follow up with the rollout plan in the morning and paste links to PRs + traces here. Thanks everyone.
